transcript.content: Hi, welcome in. I'm Dr. Smith. To start off, can you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Well... I suppose I'm here because I've been trying to get someone to take this seriously for over a year now. It's about my job. 

The... the new ticket rotation system and the security audits they keep running. I know they're being used to build a paper trail against me. I've tried to explain it, but management just keeps showing me system logs and telling me it's just standard policy. But it's not. I just... I need someone to actually look at what's happening.
Over this past year, have you noticed any changes in your mood, like feeling unusually down, hopeless, or on the other hand, unusually energetic or elated, along with these concerns about work?

No... I haven't noticed anything like that. I'm not... depressed, or whatever you said. My mood is fine. 

I'm just... focused on what's happening at the office. It's stressful, obviously, dealing with all of this, but... that's it.
Have you ever heard voices, sounds, or seen things that other people around you don't seem to notice or hear?
No. I... no. I don't hear things. Or see things. Nothing like that. I'm just looking at the actual system logs.
Aside from what's happening at work, do you find yourself distrustful or suspicious of the motives of other people in your life, like friends or family members?
No. Just... the people at work. My family is fine. I don't really see my friends that much lately, but... no, I don't have any reason to suspect them of anything. It's just the office.

Aside from the situation at work, how have things been going in other areas of your life lately — are you still keeping up with your usual responsibilities, hobbies, and daily routines the way you used to?

Things are fine. I... I still do what I need to do. I keep the house clean, pay the bills. I help my wife when she needs it. 

Even at work, the actual technical stuff... I still handle it. Nobody's ever said my work is sloppy or... disorganized. It's just the ticket rotation and the audits that are the problem. But everything else is... normal.
Have you been using any alcohol, recreational drugs, or new medications during this past year when these concerns about work started?
No. I don't... I don't use anything like that. No drugs. I hardly ever drink. And... no, no new medications either.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient presents with a fixed, non-bizarre persecutory delusion (belief that workplace systems are being used to build a case against him) persisting for over a year. There are no hallucinations, no mood episode symptoms, no disorganized speech/behavior, and overall functioning (occupational, household, marital) remains largely intact except for the circumscribed delusional belief. Substance use and medical causes were denied. This pattern—an isolated, well-systematized delusion without broader psychotic or mood symptoms and with preserved functioning—is most consistent with Delusional Disorder (F22) rather than Schizophrenia (which requires broader symptoms/functional decline) or a mood disorder with psychotic features (no mood symptoms endorsed).
